description: the tool_calls run with the slog bridge on (otel.SlogHandler bound to the pipeline, the OTLP destination opted in with otel.AppLogs(true)): mw.Log's two lines per model call under each chat span and the tool handler's WARN under its execute_tool span arrive as app log records — no weft.run.id, attributed to the run through their spans (§4's app log records), severity DEBUG 5 / WARN 13, attributes flattened; a line logged outside any span is not bridged. The root span carries weft.logs.bridged (int, the lines bridged before the run began: 0) — the logs route's mark, not metadata (meta omits it); the row is tool_calls' own. The generator sets mw.Log's measured dur to 1ms
